summary: The former LottieFiles React player is deprecated in its own README and its GitHub repository is archived. It still depends on lottie-web, has no npm provenance and has not shipped since January 2025. Do not adopt it; use @lottiefiles/dotlottie-react instead.
reasoning: The package README explicitly marks it deprecated and redirects to @lottiefiles/dotlottie-react.
The GitHub repository is archived; the last release is 3.6.0 on 2025-01-14.
It depends on lottie-web ^5.12.2, inheriting the stale JSON renderer and its eval usage.
The package itself is MIT, has bundled types and no install scripts, but maintenance and release integrity fail the requirement.
caveats: Archived and deprecated; no future fixes.

evidence.label: Deprecation status
evidence.detail: The README says the package is deprecated and no longer maintained; the GitHub repository is archived.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT; the isolated tree is MIT.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: One runtime dependency, lottie-web ^5.12.2; 35 MB installed with React; 2.9 MB unpacked.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script in the isolated tree.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: OSV returned no advisories at the reviewed version.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: 3.6.0 published 2025-01-14; repository archived; no release in more than 12 months.
